title: Keepsake Ticket
domain: Create and review the Eazo photo-to-ticket keepsake flow while preserving the original photograph and tactile two-dimensional visual rules.
scenario: Turn one real travel or everyday photo into a personal illustrated ticket through three tactile gestures.
steps: Choose a real travel or everyday photograph and keep its original framing intact.
Mark one meaningful point and apply a date stamp with immediate paper-and-ink feedback.
Tear the perforated stub to reveal the finished 3:4 photo-and-ticket keepsake.
Restart with the same or a different photograph without retaining private image data.
evidence: Completed core loop plus explicit rights and readiness blockers.
